question: Which state has the highest population in India as per the projected data of 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India, with a projected population of over 240 million as per the data for 2024.
 
• The state contributes approximately 16% of India's total population, making it the largest contributor to the country's demographic statistics.
 
• Major cities like Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi, Noida, and Agra are key contributors to the state's urban population.
 
• Uttar Pradesh's population density is among the highest in the country, largely due to its vast area and agricultural economy.
 
• Population growth in Uttar Pradesh has shown a slight decline over recent years due to increased awareness about family planning and government initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Population Density:**

 
 
• Refers to the number of people living per square kilometer of land area.
 
• Uttar Pradesh has one of the highest population densities in India, leading to significant pressure on resources and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Urbanization Trends:**
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is rapidly urbanizing, with cities like Ghaziabad and Noida emerging as major business hubs.
 
• Urban areas contribute significantly to the state's economy and population dynamics.
 
 
 
• **Fertility Rate:**
 
 
• The Total Fertility Rate (TFR) in Uttar Pradesh has historically been higher than the national average but is steadily declining.
 
• Government campaigns and education programs have contributed to reducing the TFR over time.
 
 
 
• **Challenges of High Population:**
 
 
• High population levels lead to issues such as unemployment, pressure on healthcare systems, and demand for education infrastructure.
 
• Efforts are being made to improve resource management and provide adequate public services.
 
 
 
• **Census Data and Projections:**
 
 
• India conducts a census every 10 years, with the last census held in 2011.
 
• Population projections are used in intervening years, with the next official census scheduled for 2031.
